newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin stake sale could be in March - report.
newsitem.headline: Serfin stake sale could be in March - report.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Financiero Serfin SA de CV could sell up to 19.9 percent of the banking group to London-based HSBC Holdings Plc in the second half of March, Mexican newspaper Reforma reported on Tuesday.

The newspaper quoted the company's director of communications, Roberto Aguirre, saying that the long-rumored sale could be announced in the second half of the month following a meeting of the board of directors on March 14.

He said that the final price of the deal would be difficult to say exactly, because the share price could fluctuate before the deal is signed. Serfin officials were not immediately available for comment.
Serfin is Mexico's third largest bank but has been plagued by debt worries.
